notes.title: Version 3.0 has been released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32650522/25fd8df69da5cbd33b40ec958108c600312a3e6a.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Folks! [/h2]
People, I have some great news for you! I'm happy to announce I have decided to start polishing Slab and add a few updates in the near future, the first has arrived today. 

The second thing important to tell you the price of the Slab is now $3,99!

[h2]Changelog of version 3.0:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update the game engine to the latest versions, the game has better performance
[*] Support for M1 Chip (MacOS)
[*] The speed of the ball decreased
[*] Allow controlling the paddle by the keyboard
[*] Fix the irritating bug with a disappearing ball
[*] The leaderboards were removed because a lot of people try to cheat
[*] Fix duplicates of resolutions in settings
[*] The paddle speed in settings means now the speed of the paddle when you are controlled by the keyboard.
[*] The speed of the paddle depends now on the sensitivity of your OS when you are controlling by mouse
[*] Fix the behavior of bullets when they hit the top collider
[*] Small fixes of UI
[*] Small fixes for Linux
[/list]

notes.title: New levels were added! - Version 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32650522/60ac795ee8b0ad0a21478eedc47c925663ccb057.jpg[/img]Hello community,

I've added new 20 levels to slab, and it's the last update with levels!

I added features listed below:
- 20 levels
- 20 achievements
- exploding color now based on brick color
- ball speed was increased by 20%
- max ball speed was increased by 10%
- power ups falling speed was increased by 100%
- new build on linux with x86_64 architecture
 

Enjoy! :D

notes.title: Version 1.2 with Linux + SteamOS
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32650522/f21306cae8f33a53be3ee2ec2dcaa7018c990dd1.jpg[/img]
Hello,

I released a new big version of Slab for Windows, Mac and Linux + Steam OS.

Changelog:
- Magnetic bug should not come back
- New five tracks of audio were added
- Support Linux + Steam OS, if you see any bugs please let me know
- The bug with losting mouse focus on two monitors should be fixed
- A little small bugs were fixed and little features were added

In near future I will added more levels to the game, be patient.

Please add a steam review for my game after when you play, I will be very gratefull.

Enjoy!
